Title: Found Earth's Collagen C Jelly PremiumRich at Don Quijote — Their First Premium Line in 15 Years

Description:
This is Earth Pharmaceutical's Collagen C Jelly PremiumRich (Golden Pineapple flavor), spotted on a Don Quijote shelf in Osaka. This collagen jelly line has sold since 2011, but the premium version only launched for the first time in October 2025 — beauty ingredients went from 7 to 10, with a new ingredient called glucosylceramide added, and one box packs 37,500mg of fish collagen. Reviews for the line are mixed: some love the tangy berry flavor and chewy texture, others find the gelatin taste and artificial sweetener too strong.
